title: PASHOYA Pain Salt – Joint Support & Natural Body Detox Salt
description: Hakiman PASHOYA Pain Salt is a mineral-rich bath and foot soak blend designed to turn everyday bathing into a relaxing self-care experience. Its carefully selected combination of Epsom Salt, Sajji Khar, Bhind Salt, Java Khar and refreshing essential oils creates a soothing soak for tired feet and muscles.

Simply add PASHOYA Pain Salt to warm water and soak your feet or body for 15–20 minutes. The aromatic blend of Eucalyptus, Mint, Lavender, Bergamot, Orange and Lemongrass oils adds a refreshing and calming sensory experience.
Ideal for those looking to relax after a long day, refresh tired feet and enjoy a simple, natural wellness ritual at home
keyBenefits: Helps relax tired muscles, soothe tired feet, ease everyday discomfort and provide a refreshing and calming bathing experience.
